simple.meaning: בִּירָנִית (bîyrânîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fortress.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּירָנִית (H1003) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Chronicles 17:12, with occurrences in 2 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּירָנִית (H1003) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּירָנִית (H1003) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּירָנִית (bîyrânîyth) / H1003 is traced through 2 Chronicles 17:12, 2 Chronicles 27:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1003. biyraniyth [ בִּירָנִית ] noun feminine fortress, fortified place (late); only plural absolute מִסְכְּנוֺת וְעָרֵי בִּירָנִיּוֺת 2Chr 17:12 built by Jehoshaphat; ׳בּ וּמִגְדָּלִים 27:4 built by Jotham.

occurrences.englishText: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.
